name: TooltipBase
root: none (context only; the trigger is the consumer's element)

keys.effect: closes the tooltip; focus stays on the trigger
focus leaves the trigger and the tooltip closes

focus.initial: focus stays on the trigger; keyboard focus opens the tooltip at once, a resting pointer after the delay
focus.movement: none: the tooltip holds no interactive content and is never focused

accessibleName: the trigger keeps its own name; the open tooltip describes it through aria-describedby
